fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary on Miami city commission conflict with Mayor Sewell and proposed business/liquor fees; extensive coverage of a legal challenge involving the Miami Jockey Club and pari-mutuel operations (interrogatories filed in Dade Circuit Court naming Joseph E. Widener and others); and announcements and promotional coverage related to racing and sports (including Hialeah race track and boxing). Also contains radio program schedules, nightlife/entertainment listings, advertisements, and community notes/columns.
